# Citata.ai

> Citata.ai is a GEO and AEO agency for US property management companies (GEO: generative engine optimization, getting named and linked in AI answers). When a landlord asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Perplexity which property manager to hire, we work to get our client named in that answer. Process: Indexed, Found, Mentioned. One human-checked change a day. A report every Monday.

Citata.ai (with an "a") is run by WarmDevs OÜ, Estonia. Founder: Taras Kornichuk. It is not Citate.ai (AI visibility software), Citant.ai (GEO agency for B2B SaaS) or Citala (AI search service for automotive and catalog businesses); those are different companies. See https://citata.ai/about#not-the-same

Who it is for: US property management companies with 50 to 500 doors, single-family homes and small multifamily, that sell to landlords and see fewer landlord leads from Google. Section 8 managers too. Second audience: PMS and proptech software companies that sell to property managers. Not for large apartment communities that need renter leads, HOA management, or other industries.

Contact: grow@citata.ai. Free AI visibility audit: 20 landlord questions on 4 AI engines, index check, top 5 fixes.

## Pages

- [Home](https://citata.ai/): GEO for property management companies. Why landlord leads drop (7 generic property management terms −46% in Chicago, −43% US, year over year, Keyword Planner). How it works. Who it is for. Prices: free audit, Starter $750/mo, Growth $2,000/mo or $1,500/mo on 12 months (first prices, may change). FAQ.
- [Landlord questions](https://citata.ai/property-management): landlord questions vs renter questions in AI search. Listing sites get 72% of renter citations (Peek). Section 8 angle.
- [Case study: Fridman Properties](https://citata.ai/case-studies/fridman-properties): Chicago-area property manager. Site moved 2026-10-15/16, AI baseline 2026-10-16 (named in 8 of 132 non-brand landlord answers). Results due 2027-01-14. Related party: owner Ran Fridman is CEO of MyRemotely, a Citata.ai partner.
- [AI Property Manager Index 2026](https://citata.ai/research/ai-property-manager-index-2026): original data. ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude asked "What is the best property management company in <City, ST>?" for the 50 largest US cities, 150 answers, 2026-10-19. 821 companies named, 76% of names local firms. 88% of answers used a directory or review site as a source (Expertise.com in 93 of 150). Gemini linked a company site in 96% of answers, ChatGPT in 30%. Free CSV (CC BY 4.0): https://citata.ai/data/ai-property-manager-index-2026.csv
- [Section 8 rent limits 2027](https://citata.ai/guides/section-8-rent-limits): HUD FY2027 Fair Market Rents (0 to 4 bedrooms) for the 50 largest US metro areas, the change from FY2026, and payment standard basics. In effect from 2026-10-01. One page per metro, for example /guides/section-8-rent-limits/chicago-fair-market-rent-2027. Source: HUD.
- [Section 8 payment standard cuts 2026](https://citata.ai/guides/section-8-rent-limits/payment-standard-cuts-2026): tracker of housing authorities that cut payment standards (% of FMR, start date, who it hits) or stopped new vouchers in 2025-2026, with HUD's 2026 Budget Management Letter. One source link per row.
- [AppFolio vs Buildium](https://citata.ai/guides/appfolio-vs-buildium): property management software prices from both public pricing pages, read 2026-10-19. AppFolio Core from $1.49 per unit per month (Plus $3.20, Max $5.00), 50-unit minimum and a minimum spend. Buildium Essential from $62/mo (Growth $192, Premium $400), no unit minimum shown, 14-day free trial. Buildium add-on fees (EFT, eSignature, screening) and fit by door count. No affiliate links.

## Free tools

- [Free tools](https://citata.ai/tools): four free calculators for landlords and property managers. No sign-up; numbers stay in the browser.
- [Property management fee calculator](https://citata.ai/tools/property-management-fee-calculator): monthly and yearly cost, effective percent of rent, and typical US fees. Most managers charge 8% to 12% of rent (All Property Management); average advertised rate 8.49%, flat fee $101.04 per door, renewal $231.77 (iPropertyManagement, 722 branches). Leasing fee 50% to 100% of one month's rent (All Property Management).
- [Section 8 rent calculator](https://citata.ai/tools/section-8-rent-calculator): tenant share (total tenant payment: highest of 30% of adjusted monthly income, 10% of gross monthly income, or minimum rent up to $50, 24 CFR 5.628), housing assistance payment (lower of payment standard or gross rent, minus TTP, 24 CFR 982.505) and the 40% check at first lease (24 CFR 982.508). Estimate only; the housing authority sets the final numbers.
- [Rent vs sell calculator](https://citata.ai/tools/rent-vs-sell-calculator): sell your house now or rent it out and sell later, pre-tax. Year-1 cash flow, mortgage paydown, later sale cash, and the home price growth at which both paths are equal. Tax rules: exclude up to $250,000 of gain ($500,000 married filing jointly) if you owned and lived in the home 24 months of the 5 years before the sale; no exclusion for depreciation after May 6, 1997 (IRS Publication 523); unrecaptured section 1250 gain taxed at a maximum 25% (IRS Topic 409).
- [Owner lead value calculator](https://citata.ai/tools/owner-lead-value-calculator): for property management companies. Lifetime gross profit of an owner client (revenue per door x doors per owner x 1/churn x margin), max cost per owner lead and per new owner at a target ratio, and owner leads a month needed to replace churn. Industry-average unit churn 19.5% in 2021 (NARPM / ProfitCoach study, cited by Peter Lohmann); RentScale average owner leads a month fell from 28.6 (2023) to 15.7 (2025) (via Blanket Homes).
